title: Quota Snapshot
description: A device-scoped, point-in-time view of one provider's quota. A window with status `unknown` means the provider did not expose a reliable value; `unavailable` means collection was attempted but failed. In either state, numeric quota values and reset_at must be null.

schema_version.description: Version of this payload contract. Consumers must reject unsupported versions rather than guessing their shape.

provider.description: Provider account whose quota was observed. A snapshot contains exactly one provider.

windows.description: Quota windows reported by the provider, keyed by provider-stable window name. Object keys make each window name unique within a snapshot.

source.description: Mechanism from which the snapshot was collected; local_cache identifies a previously collected offline value.

collected_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp at which the represented values were collected. For local_cache this remains the original collection time, not the cache-read time.

device_id.description: Stable, non-secret identifier of the collecting device within the tenant.

idempotency_key.description: Client-generated UUID used to deduplicate retries of the same snapshot.

status.description: available: reliable numeric values were collected; unknown: collection succeeded but the provider did not expose reliable values; unavailable: collection was attempted but failed.

used.description: Amount consumed in the provider-native unit; null unless status is available.

limit.description: Positive quota ceiling in the same unit as used and remaining; null unless status is available.

remaining.description: Provider-reported remaining quota in the same unit as used and limit; null unless status is available.

reset_at.description: RFC 3339 reset time when exposed by the provider. It may be null for an available non-resetting window, and must be null for unknown or unavailable.
